purpose: Teach: 入園/ミニマム/コンソーシアム/原本/諸般/目途/休刊/乗り出す

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員のお子様の入園のお祝いを贈りましょう
lines.en: Let's send a gift to celebrate the employee's child starting nursery school.
lines.style: Brisk, clear direction. No hesitation. Efficient tone that expects quick agreement. Professional and kind at once.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費はミニマムに抑える方針です
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep the budget to a minimum.
lines.style: Immediate affirmation. Cooperative tone, slightly lower in register. Acknowledges the direction and signals readiness to execute.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界コンソーシアム会議に出席しましょう
lines.en: Let's attend the industry consortium conference.
lines.style: Directive tone. Measured pace. The opening word carries light weight — she's proposing something already decided. Steady eye contact in her voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類の原本は金庫に保管します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep the original documents in the safe.
lines.style: Confirming with a procedural detail. Slight downward inflection — confirming what's been implied. Matter-of-fact, reliable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 諸般の状況を勘案して提案します
lines.en: I'll make a proposal considering the full situation.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful direction. Pause just before the verb — showing she's thought this through. Confident but not dismissive of complexity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新システム導入の目途を立てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll set a timeline for the new system rollout.
lines.style: Immediate agreement. Slightly energized — he's ready to move forward. The verb carries forward momentum. Supportive without overstating.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合誌の休刊が業界に与える影響を分析しましょう
lines.en: Let's analyze how the competitor magazine's suspension will affect the industry.
lines.style: Strategic direction. Slower, deliberate pace — this is the kind of thinking that requires attention. Opens with quiet weight. The verb lands firmly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービスに乗り出す方針です
lines.en: Yes. Our policy is to move into new service areas.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slight warmth underneath the professional tone — they've reached agreement. Closes with quiet confidence, no trailing off.
